title: Cedevita Olimpija hold off Krka to earn Liga Nova KBM title
description: Cedevita Olimpija - Krka 72-65 Cedevita Olimpija celebrated the fifth straight Liga Nova KBM title. They beat Krka in the fourth game of the championship series to defend the title. Brynton Lemar (193-SG-1995, college: UC Davis) finished with 16 points to pace the winners. Krka looked solid in the first half. The visitors set the tone early as they eked out a 19-17 lead after ten minutes. Krka extended the lead to 5 points at halftime 38-33. But Cedevita Olimpija erased the deficit in the third period. They tied things up at 53 heading into the fourth quarter. Cedevita Olimpija then went on a strong 19-12 run in the final period to ice the victory. Aleksej Nikolic (191-PG-1995) provided 14 points for the winners. Niko Bacvic (191-PG-1997) answered with 17 points, while Jaka Klobucar (199-G-2003) netted 14 points for Krka.
